title: Dropdown menu below a button
summary: An absolute menu with top: 100% opens directly under its trigger, without pushing the content below it.
explanation: The wrapper is position: relative, so the menu is placed against it. top: 100% puts the menu's top edge at the bottom of the wrapper, which is just under the button.
The menu is absolute, so it floats above the content that follows. z-index: 1 keeps it on top of the cards below. The menu is always open here; a real one would toggle it on click.
tryThis: Remove position: relative from .wrap: the menu jumps to the top-left of the preview.
Change top to 100% to 50%: the menu now overlaps the button.
Remove z-index from .menu and see whether the cards below cover it.

items.text: The content below the menu stays where it is.
